correctness.rationale: The published semantic clause is exactly set-theoretic material implication on team propositions. Both sufficiency directions follow by assuming a failed union/intersection and forcing its two inputs into the consequent. Both necessity directions use explicit singleton consequents. The weak operator changes only the empty-team intersection boundary. Finite exhaustive verification for all team propositions on bases of size at most three matches the symbolic criteria.

value.rationale: Closure preservation is one of the three central desiderata in the source paper, and global failure drives its impossibility theorems. The accepted theorem replaces that failure by an exact structural boundary and identifies the safe union-closed empty-team fragment with flat principal ideals. The endpoint exceptions also explain precisely why naive full downward/upward closure is not the optimal criterion.
